notes.serialization: Python Ultralytics Results object; this schema describes the decoded property projection, not an author JSON exporter.
notes.coordinates: obb.xyxyxyxy contains four ordered original-image pixel corners, top-left origin; orig_shape is [height,width].
notes.scope: Postprocessed oriented detection Results, not horizontal boxes, segmentation masks, or raw network tensors. obb.data retains producer xywhr and optional track IDs as native metadata.
notes.conversion: ISIR preserves the oriented center/width/height box with angle in radians, counterclockwise in bottom-left coordinates, plus the four-corner polygon. Native angles and labels/classes remain metadata. COCO exports an axis-aligned envelope bbox and polygon segmentation. No area is inferred.
